title: Rule
description: A kernel rule record. Geometric and DRC rules use the optional fields kind, variant, scope.expr, scope.expr_b, scope.pair, layers, constraint, priority, origin, floor_exempt, enabled and native, defined in schemas/rule-taxonomy.md section 2.

kind.description: Canonical rule kind id from schemas/rule-taxonomy.md section 3. Omitted for rules that bind only to a check callable.

variant.description: Sub-check of a kind that groups several native checks (listed per kind in rule-taxonomy.md section 3).

scope.description: At least one selector. A rule applies when every given selector matches.

expr.description: Canonical scope expression (rule-taxonomy.md section 2.4) for the first (or only) object. For a binary rule without expr_b it may name A. and B. explicitly.

expr_b.description: Canonical scope expression for the second object of a binary rule. Not allowed for unary kinds.

pair.description: Relations the object pair must satisfy (Altium NETSCOPE and LAYERKIND, KiCad AB.isCoupledDiffPair()).

symmetric.description: Match the pair in either order.

layers.description: Layer filter: canonical layer ids (cu:1 ... cu:N, silk:top, mask:bottom, edge, user:<name>) or tokens (outer, inner, copper, all); glob wildcards allowed. Omitted = all layers.

constraint.description: Rule parameters. min / opt / max are numbers in unit; value carries tokens, flags, lists or expressions.

options.description: Named switches of a kind, e.g. within_diff_pairs for skew.

priority.description: Order among rules of one kind and origin; 1 is highest (rule-taxonomy.md section 5, P3).

origin.description: Precedence tier (rule-taxonomy.md section 5, P1 and P3). item_default: an object-level setting that applies only when no explicit rule matches (KiCad footprint zone connection; a zone's own connection, thermal gap and spoke width).

floor_exempt.description: The rule may resolve below the board floor (never below a fab floor without a waiver).

native.description: The tool construct this rule was imported from or is exported to; kept for round trips.

kind.description: Native kind: DRU keyword, board-setup key, Altium RULEKIND, Eagle param name.

name.description: Native rule name (KiCad rule name, Altium NAME).

text.description: Native rule or condition text, verbatim.

version.description: Tool or file-format version the text belongs to.

severity.description: ignore: matched objects produce no finding. inherit: use the rule set's default severity for the kind (rule-taxonomy.md section 2.7).

check.description: Dotted path to a callable in pcbbrain_checks, e.g. pcbbrain_checks.rules.cap_between_pins; for taxonomy kinds pcbbrain_checks.drc.<kind> or pcbbrain_checks.erc.<kind>
